text: when painting, if i have say 3 layers and i paint on the top most layer, and then go and paint on a layer below it, and i paint under where it would be from the layer on top. it shows as painting on top of that layer, until the next undo command which then shifts it under
resolution: Fixed paint-layer ordering at the stroke boundary. Live dabs still write directly into the shared atlas for responsiveness, but pointer-up now detects when the active layer is hidden or has any visible layer above it and immediately replays the canonical bottom-to-top program. A lower-layer stroke therefore settles beneath upper layers as soon as the stroke commits instead of waiting for a later Undo to incidentally recomposite it. Added a focused Zig truth-table test for all visible/covered cases and verified the full model-paint suite plus the editor ReleaseFast build.
